# Ujrat — Free Freelance Invoicing, GST & Zero-Fee UPI Payments Platform

> Ujrat (https://ujrat.ninety5.in) is the #1 free, open-source freelance workflow platform engineered for Indian freelancers, consultants, and creative professionals. It provides client CRM, IT Act 2000 compliant digital contracts with e-signatures, automated CGST/SGST/IGST invoicing, direct zero-commission UPI QR payment payouts, and file delivery escrow.

## Core Capabilities & Features

- **Client CRM**: Manage client contacts, GSTIN tax identifiers, addresses, active engagements, and payment histories.
- **GST Invoicing Engine**: Automated place-of-supply tax calculations for intra-state (CGST + SGST) and inter-state (IGST) services under SAC/HSN codes (e.g. 998314 for IT consulting). Includes PDF export and invoice versioning.
- **Zero-Fee UPI Payments**: Direct UPI intent generation and dynamic QR code billing without payment gateway merchant charges (0% fee direct to freelancer bank account).
- **Digital Contracts & Proposals**: E-signature workflows with cryptographic signature audit logs adhering to the Indian Information Technology Act, 2000.
- **Client Portal & Escrow File Delivery**: Passwordless token-based client portal with OTP verification for reviewing contracts, paying invoices, and unlocking project deliverables.

## Technical Architecture & Security

- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS) policies guaranteeing workspace data isolation.
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS with zero render-blocking assets.
- **License**: MIT Open Source License.
